about: Every old-name hit (job-pilotto in any spelling) is owned by the FIRST rule whose match/before/after/line/paths all fit. step = the commit of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-01-finish-jobadabra-rename-design.md: 3 prose and local names, 4 in-page names, 5 env/header/telemetry/package names, 6 Keychain (with read-old fallback). keep = stays on purpose (why, expires). owner = another session's sweep.

skip.why: dated specs and plans are a record of what was true then; the rename spec itself names the old words
the rename tooling spells the old names
the guard spells the old names
pins the old data folder and Safe Storage name
rs: deleted or moved to another repo
guards the release asset names; spells the old ones

rules.keep: Electron's Keychain item that seals every saved token; renaming makes them unreadable
installed apps call www.jobpilotto.top: a live address, not a name
installed apps POST to these workers.dev hosts

rules.owner: go: every GarryOne/ literal is swept by go (PRs 3/7 to 6/7)

rules.keep: GitHub variable/secret name: mac-07 renames it (the owner's call), then this reference changes
rules.expires: when mac-07 has renamed the variable or secret

rules.keep: the Sentry account's org and project slugs

rules.expires: when the owner renames the Notion pages
